Mimosa Hostilis Powdered Root Bark & Syrian Rue Powdered Seeds
I had just finished my final exams and had a beautifully relaxing day outside playing volleyball with some friends. We went out to dinner afterwards and the topic of entheogens, specifically DMT as it was something I had planned to consume for many years and finally gotten around to purchasing the necessaries. After a light dinner and two beers I went home, where my girlfriend was still studying for her last final exam. Still very happy, I decided to try the plant materials I had bought, just out of curiosity in a very low dose. (Note: I have consumed Psilocybe Mushrooms twice before and enjoyed the experiences, as well as having indulged in plenty Marijuana).
10:30pm
I Weigh out 5 grams of Mimosa Hostilis Powdered Root Bark and place it in a crock pot at low heat with 200 mL of tap water and 30 mL of White Vinegar (5% Acetic Acid). I leave this to brew while I go to watch an episode of a TV show with my girlfriend while she takes a break from studying. I occasionally stir the mixture.
11:30pm
I transfer the Mimosa mixture to a stainless steel pot and put it on low heat. I also weigh out 2.5 grams of powdered Syrian Rue seeds powdered with a coffee grinder.
11:45pm
The mixture has now boiled down to about 15 mL which a strain and squeeze out through a cutting of cotton cloth, leaving the brown Mimosa behind and a brown liquid. The brown colour is that of the high level of tannin in Mimosa Root Bark, so I place the mixture in a stainless steel sauce pan with 1 egg white and another 15 mL of water and mix, after which I turn the heat up to medium to solidify the egg whites, which turn brown as the tannin is soaked up.
I strained this through a cotton cloth cutting as well and thoroughly squeeze out the liquid from the egg white. The resulting liquid fits in a shot glass and is clear, but slightly murky. This lets me know that I have gotten rid of the tannin, which should halt the nausea.
11:55pm
I place the 2.5g of Syrian Rue powder in a small glass of Orange Juice and drink it all up. I don't mind the taste. I have slowly over the past week tried 1 gram amounts of the Syrian Rue to accustom myself to the taste and with the assumption that the reversible MAOI (harmaline) acts as a mild anti-depressant and mood enhancer, which I felt I needed.
00:10am
I place the resulting clear liquid I mentioned before in a half glass of diet coca cola. I drink this quickly as well and go join my girlfriend who is still studying.
00:30am
I am starting to feel something, which reminds me of coming up on Psilocybin mushrooms, but it is very mild and making me smile.
00:35am
The effects of the DMT have definitely kicked in, but is very mild as I become euphoric (similar to the experience of Marijuana) and very talkative.
I become euphoric (similar to the experience of Marijuana) and very talkative.
I also keep distracting my girlfriend and talk about how happy I am and how relaxing this feels. No visuals though, and closing my eyes gives me the feeling of being hit by sound waves, three at a time, but nothing more. Bright light is a little unnerving and I can't keep my mind focused on any one idea for too long. This is still very mild and I am enjoying the euphoria and happiness.
1:00am
My girlfriend tells me to go bother my roommate and let her study, so I wander to his room where he is studying as well. We talk for a while and I explain the experience to him, as well as my previous trips. He is curious and doesn't mind my continuous chatter and losing track of thought. I am thoroughly enjoying this and feel at this point that I would definitely recommend a first time trip on DMT at this dose.
2:00am
The experience starts to come down significantly and a still feel very relaxed. I tinker around with some of my belongings, like a singing and dancing flower pot that needed to have its batteries replaced. I am thoroughly amused but getting a little tired. This is when my girlfriend and I decide to go to bed.
I sleep extremely well that night and wake up very refreshed and calm. I have a few relaxing dreams I can't recall. I do remember that during the experience I was reminded of several dreams locations I had had before, but nothing too intense, just fleeting thoughts.
The experience was very pleasant and a good threshold dosage to try first time tripping on DMT orally. I will try a stronger dose next time (10g Mimosa, 3.5 Syrian Rue in gelatin capsules) to feed my curiosity.
